configurePresets.name: vke-debug
configurePresets.description: Debug build with assertions live, the configuration day-to-day work happens in. Writes to cmake-build-vke-debug.

configurePresets.name: vke-release
configurePresets.description: Optimized build, the build type CI covers. Writes to cmake-build-vke-release.

configurePresets.name: vke-profile
configurePresets.description: Optimized build with full debug info (a PDB next to each DLL and executable on MSVC) and frame pointers, for sampling profilers. Unlike vke-release, call stacks unwind and resolve to source lines. Writes to cmake-build-vke-profile.
